entries.title: Shrinking Oasis and Returning Grassland
entries.description: A flat terrain of small cylinders representing grass slowly fades from green to brown and shrinks during “drought,” while a transparent water table box beneath the ground drops, then slowly rises again to trigger regrowth where new green cylinders sprout, grow, and spread outward in waves.

entries.title: Tree Line Dieback and Canopy Recovery
entries.description: A grid of tree objects (cylinders with cone foliage) on a gentle hill gradually loses leaves (foliage scales down and fades to gray) from the top of the hill downward as a drought meter bar drops, then after virtual rainfall particles arrive, trees regrow foliage from the bottom up, with canopy color transitioning back to bright green.

entries.title: Soil Moisture Cubes and Root Network Regrowth
entries.description: A cross-section of soil built from semi-transparent cubes changes color from blue to yellow as moisture drains away, causing a branching root system of thin cylinders to retract and break; when a controlled water source recharges nearby cubes, roots regrow toward the wetter cubes, thickening and branching where moisture concentrates.

entries.title: Drying Riverbed and Meandering Stream Return
entries.description: A curving riverbed carved into a terrain slowly loses its blue water ribbon (a long box) that shrinks into disconnected puddles, while fish-shaped objects become motionless and fade; later, incoming rain droplets collide with the basin, refill it, merge puddles into a continuous stream, and restore fish motion and color.

entries.title: Evaporating Reservoir and Irrigation Regrowth
entries.description: A raised reservoir box with animated water level dropping feeds a network of irrigation channels that run dry over time, turning adjacent crop tiles from green plates to cracked brown plates; when a new water inflow cylinder starts filling the reservoir, channels refill, and crop tiles gradually flip back to green and sprout vertical stalks.

entries.title: City Water Towers and Neighborhood Lawn Regrowth
entries.description: Multiple spherical water towers on stilts slowly empty (water level inside transparent spheres falls) while house plots below lose their green lawn carpets to patchy brown; once trucks (small boxes) arrive and “refill” the towers on collision, sprinklers appear on lawns, emitting particle sprays that cause green patches to regrow outward.

entries.title: Forest Fire Scar and Understory Return
entries.description: A forest of tall cylinders (trunks) on a white ground plane experiences a sweeping drought-driven fire front (a moving orange-red transparent wall) that blackens trunks and removes green canopy; months later, small green sprouts and bushes appear at the bases, gradually growing upward and filling space under the charred trunks.

entries.title: Desertification Front and Vegetation Recovery Line
entries.description: A large grid of hexagonal tiles representing land gradually shifts from green to beige and then cracked brown as a “drought front” plane scans across the landscape, shrinking vegetation cones; later, a “restoration front” with light-blue glow moves back, allowing new green cones to appear and grow only where underground blue aquifer nodes reconnect.

entries.title: Household Potted Plant Drying and Revival
entries.description: A single potted plant model on a table has a soil surface disk that darkens and cracks as moisture droplets above evaporate, while leaf planes curl inward, droop, and lose color; after a watering can object tips and pours blue droplets into the pot, the leaves uncurl, regain color, and extend upward with a subtle pulsing green glow.

entries.title: Micro-scale Leaf Stomata Closing and Reopening
entries.description: A magnified leaf patch with circular stomata pores (holes in a green plane) shows guard cells as small curved cylinders that swell or shrink; during drought, the guard cells rotate and close the pores while water particles stop exiting, and during regrowth, invisible humidity triggers them to reopen, allowing new water vapor and nutrient particles to flow.

entries.title: Soil Crust Formation and Cracking with Seedling Emergence
entries.description: A dry soil surface represented by a flexible brown sheet gradually tightens and slightly lifts at the edges (simulated tension) to form a crust, then cracks into polygonal segments; small seed spheres below push upward, splitting the crust along crack lines and emerging as slender green cylinders that continue to grow and branch.

entries.title: Aquifer Depletion and Recharge with Well Fields
entries.description: Tall transparent cylinders representing wells extend into a layered subsurface of colored boxes; as pumping continues, the blue aquifer layer shrinks downward, causing nearby vegetation cones on the surface to shrink and fade, until a distant recharge river inflow raises the aquifer again, allowing the vegetation to regrow in sequence from nearest to farthest wells.

entries.title: Drip Irrigation Line and Patchy Root Zone Regrowth
entries.description: A series of emitters (small spheres) along a black hose over soil emit blue droplets when active, forming overlapping moist halos in the soil (transparent blue spheres); as drought progresses, droplets stop, halos shrink, and root segments retract; when flow resumes, halos expand, root segments grow and branch within the blue zones, and green stems above thicken.

entries.title: Reservoir Allocation and Competing Farm Regrowth
entries.description: A central lake with a floating level indicator feeds three branching canals leading to color-coded farms of cubes; as drought reduces lake volume, gate boxes at canal starts partially close, causing some farm cubes to dry and shrink while others stay green; after rainfall refills the lake, opening gates re-balance flow and dried cubes regrow at different speeds.

entries.title: Drought-Stressed Savanna with Migrating Herd and Grass Return
entries.description: A savanna plane with sparse tree cylinders and grass cylinders gradually loses grass height and color as rainfall particles stop; an animal herd (moving boxes with trails) migrates toward the last water hole, compressing and flattening remaining grass on contact; after the rainy season front returns and refills the hole, new grass cylinders sprout in the herd’s wake.

entries.title: Urban Green Roof Drying and Mosaic Regrowth
entries.description: A building roof subdivided into tiled plots of shallow soil begins fully green, then tiles at higher elevation dry first, fading to light brown and slightly sagging; a sprinkler arm sweeps across the roof, emitting fine droplet particles that rehydrate tiles, which regrow from edges inward with a spreading green color gradient.

entries.title: River Delta Wetland Drought and Channel Reoccupation
entries.description: A branching delta system made of shallow channels and wetland patches slowly loses water, leaving cracked brown plates and isolated pools; when upstream flow resumes, blue water flows down, splitting, merging, and refilling channels, and triggering regrowth of reed clusters (vertical rods) that appear first along channel edges.

entries.title: Groundwater-Dependent Spring and Oasis Regrowth
entries.description: A rocky hillside with a small spring outlet sphere shows clear water seeping out and flowing into an oasis pool feeding nearby palm-like trees; as an underground transparent blue “water lens” shrinks, spring flow weakens and trees lose fronds, but once distant recharge water cubes merge into the lens, it thickens, spring flow resumes, and palms regrow leaves.

entries.title: Microbial Biofilm Drying and Patchy Regrowth
entries.description: A wet surface with a thin semi-transparent film populated by small sphere microbes dries as airflow vectors pass over it, causing the film to shrink and break into isolated islands; when humidity spheres condense and land, specific islands swell and connect by bridging strands, and microbes replicate, recolonizing the gaps.
entries.seed: Microbial Biofilm Drying and Patchy Regrowth: A wet surface with a thin semi-transparent film populated by small sphere microbes dries as airflow vectors pass over it, causing the film to shrink and break into isolated islands; when humidity spheres condense and land, specific islands swell and connect by bridging strands, and microbes replicate, recolonizing the gaps.

entries.title: Seed Bank Dormancy and Pulsed Regrowth Cycles
entries.description: A soil column with a buried layer of seed spheres remains visually unchanged on the surface during a long drought while a humidity gauge stays low; when occasional rain pulses (blue particle bursts) reach a threshold, subsets of seeds activate, move upward, and emerge as small sprouts that either wither in the next drought or survive and thicken with repeated pulses.

entries.title: Drought-Stressed Crop Field with Center Pivot Regrowth
entries.description: A circular field with faint radial tracks from a center pivot shows plants as vertical rods that shrink and brown as a sun intensity sphere brightens overhead; a rotating sprinkler arm sweeps 360°, dripping water particles that leave wet arcs in the soil and cause rods to regrow and green up only along those arcs.

entries.title: Water Tower Network and Park Regreening
entries.description: A small town scene with a park of grass tiles, trees, and a fountain cube is fed by a tall transparent water tower that slowly empties, leading to fountain shutdown and park tiles browning from the edges inward; after a supply pipe reconnects (two cylinders collide and attach), tower level rises again, fountain resumes, and green color ripples back through the park.

entries.title: Underground Mycorrhizal Network Loss and Reconnection
entries.description: Several trees on the surface are linked underground by a glowing fungal network of thin, branching tubes; as drought progresses, segments dim and detach, and some trees lose foliage; when water is added at specific points, fungal tubes regrow toward moisture nodes, branches merge and brighten, and affected trees regain foliage in response to restored connections.

entries.title: Cracked Lakebed and Algal Mat Return
entries.description: A shallow lake represented by a transparent basin drains until only a cracked brown bottom with dormant algal patches (dark disks) remains; when water returns, slowly filling the basin, dormant disks swell, brighten to green, and expand outward as thin floating mats that merge, while suspended particle clouds appear and fade as algae uptake increases.

entries.title: Symbolic Drought Clock and Regrowth Spiral
entries.description: A central “drought clock” ring gradually empties of blue beads that fall into a dry basin, while a surrounding spiral of plant icons (small upright rectangles) wilt and turn gray; when the clock reverses and beads flow back into the ring, the spiral icons sequentially straighten, regain green color, and grow small branching protrusions that pulse gently.
